title: Dual-mechanism synergy of adsorbate evolution and lattice oxygen in high-entropy oxides for enhanced water oxidation
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EE00598E, Paper
Zhen Xin Hui, Zeliang Ju, Jia Zhao Li, Hui Li, Xu Liu, Huai Bi Hu, Zi Wen, Zhi Wen Chen, Chun Cheng Yang, Qing Jiang
A spinel-type FeCoNiCrRu high-entropy oxide is synthesized via an ultrafast thermal shock method. This catalyst overcomes the activity–stability trade-off in OER catalysis through the synergistic AEM–LOM dual-pathway mechanism.
